title: 사이시옷: 바닷가, 콧물 — 언제 ㅅ이 들어가요?
objective: You can tell when ㅅ goes into a compound noun.
summary: Learn when a linking ㅅ is added between two nouns.

task.title: Read, choose and write sounds
task.line: Use the four rules on page 1 to choose the spelling or write the real sound in [ ].

words.exampleMeaning: I'm going to the beach this weekend.
My nose is running because of a cold.
In autumn, the leaves are yellow.

letters.as: Two nouns join (at least one is a native Korean word) and the first ends in a vowel. Write ㅅ under that vowel only if the sound changes: the next consonant gets tight, or an [ㄴ]/[ㄴㄴ] sound is added.

letters.letter: ㅅ + ㄱ ㄷ ㅂ ㅅ ㅈ
letters.as: Next sound gets tight, like 'k' in 'sky'. ㅅ is silent or [ㄷ].

exercises: Choose the real sound: ① 빗소리 [비소리 / 비쏘리] ② 잇몸 [읻몸 / 인몸]
Choose the correct spelling: ① 바다 + 물 → 바다물 / 바닷물 ② 위 + 층 → 위층 / 윗층
Write the real sound in [ ]: ① 햇살 ② 뒷자리
Which change happens? Write A (next sound gets tight), B (ㅅ sounds [ㄴ]) or C (sounds [ㄴㄴ]): ① 뒷머리 ② 나뭇가지
